answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32455 Country: India Title: My Question is that if any women pray namaz wearing artificial jwellery such as bangles made up of aluminium,copper etc then her salah will be valid or not, does she need to repeat his salah? Question: My Question is that if any women pray namaz wearing artificial jwellery such as bangles made up of aluminium,copper etc then her salah will be valid or not, does she need to repeat his salah? Answer ID: 32455 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 866/716/B=1432) It is lawful for a woman to wear all types of jewelleries, and her salah shall be alright with all types of jewelleries without any doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
